plugins.name: junipersquare
plugins.description: Juniper Square is the operating system for the private markets. Query and act on your data across investor contacts, fund offerings, positions, subscriptions, documents, and more.

skills.name: entity-org-chart
skills.description: Build an investment-entity org chart for a Juniper Square workspace — boxes and lines, with ownership percentages on every edge. Use when the user says "org chart", "organizational chart", "entity structure diagram", "ownership chart", "ownership graph", "nested entity structure", "boxes and lines", "draw my fund structure", "visualize my entities", "where is investor X invested", "show me Fund Y's structure", "what does Fund Y own", or asks for a roll-up of all positions owned by an investment entity. Use whenever the deliverable is an entity-to-entity (or investor-to-entity) ownership picture, rendered as a stacked-card report or as a roll-up table. Do NOT trigger for fundraise pipeline questions, performance / NAV roll-ups outside an entity tree, or documents / data-room questions.
headings: The one fact that makes the walk possible
skills.description_zh: 为Juniper Square工作区构建投资实体或投资人所有权结构图，在每条连线上显示持有比例，支持实体树内持仓汇总和卡片报告或表；不用于募资管道、实体树外NAV绩效或数据室。

skills.name: investor-tearsheet
skills.description: Prep a GP for an LP or prospect interaction with a source-attributed tearsheet. Pulls Juniper Square connector data, scans the contact's public footprint, surfaces fundraising and investment facts, and produces a scannable briefing. Triggers; "tearsheet for [contact]", "LP tearsheet", "pull a tearsheet on [contact]", "prep me for my meeting with [LP]", "GP meeting prep for [contact]", "brief me on [LP]". Standalone-capable; supercharged by the Juniper Square connector and workplace tools.
skills.description_zh: 为GP与LP或潜在投资人会面准备带来源归属的速览，结合Juniper Square连接器、公开背景及工作工具呈现募资和投资事实，支持独立使用。

skills.name: jsq-report-render
skills.description: Render kept, branded Juniper Square (JSQ) report deliverables in the output window — tearsheets, fundraise action reports, entity org charts, portfolio/pipeline summaries, financial briefs. A thin brand layer driven by vetted reference renders. NOT for ephemeral in-chat answers or throwaway inline widgets. Consumer skills own report content; this skill owns the brand layer, the reference examples, and the render contract.
headings: Scope — when this skill fires (and when it doesn't)
Render contract (every JSQ report follows these 3 steps)
Step 1 — Open the matching reference example (do this first)
Step 2 — Apply the brand patch + conventions
Step 3 — Pick the render target (file or artifact)
JSQ brand patch (overrides on the example)
What this skill does not own
skills.description_zh: 为可保存的Juniper Square速览、募资行动、实体结构、组合管道及财务报告应用经验证示例驱动的品牌呈现层，内容由调用技能负责；不用于临时聊天回答或一次性小组件。

skills.name: juniper-square-data-model
skills.description: Reference for the Juniper Square data model — the core objects (Contact, Account, Offering, Prospect, Subscription, Position, Investment Entity, Activity, etc.), how they relate, and how to reason about them when answering questions or calling Juniper Square MCP tools. Use this skill whenever a user asks about Juniper Square data — investors, fundraises, offerings, subscriptions, capital calls, NAV, distributions, GP workspaces — or any time you need to resolve what a term like "entity" or "investor" maps to before querying. Also use when aggregating across Juniper Square records, when disambiguating objects that share a name, or when deciding which object holds the answer (e.g., Subscription vs. Position for committed vs. executed capital).
headings: How to reason about Juniper Square data
skills.name_hint: juniper · square · 数据 · 模型
skills.description_zh: 解释Juniper Square联系人、账户、发行、潜客、认购、持仓、投资实体与活动等对象关系，支持查询前术语映射、同名消歧及聚合，区分认购承诺与已执行持仓等口径。

skills.name: offering-action-report
skills.description: Build a single-offering fundraise ACTION report for a Juniper Square GP — a static HTML page that leads with what to do today, then backs it with the subscription funnel, the exact subscription step each in-flight investor is on (from mainStates.stages), and data-room engagement. Use whenever a GP asks for a fundraise status, "what needs my attention on [offering]", where investors are stuck, a subscription / closing status check, a daily raise update, or "action report for [offering]". Trigger even when the user doesn't say "action report" — a request to see the state of one fundraise and what to act on is enough. Built entirely on SUBSCRIPTION STATUS; it does not use prospect status.
headings: Be reactive to the data, not to a fixed list
skills.description_zh: 为Juniper Square单一发行生成以今日行动为首的静态HTML募资报告，依据认购状态展示漏斗、每位投资人的确切阶段及数据室参与，识别卡点和结案进度，不使用潜客状态。
